segments.name: investment management
segments.description: Manages investment portfolios and funds for institutional and retail clients.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it has one reporting unit for goodwill impairment testing purposes, the consolidated BlackRock single operating segment, which is consistent with internal management reporting and management's oversight of operations.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay investment advisory and administration fees for managing their assets.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives a substantial portion of its revenue from investment advisory and administration fees, which are recognized as the services are performed over time because the customer is receiving and consuming the benefits as they are provided by the Company.
